summary.en: Four cells, each running its own brick, start a few frames apart and play at once, each labelled on a chip.
summary.zh: 四个格子各跑一块积木，相隔几帧依次起动、同时播放，每格左上角有一枚标签。

fits: Four features or results at once, each with its own small motion (demo, proof).
notFor: Bricks that need the full frame to read (type below the quarter-frame floor); more or fewer than four things; a calm section.

intent.en: Information overload on purpose: four things happen at once and some quarter moves every few frames, so the viewer feels how much the product does.
intent.zh: 刻意的信息轰炸：四件事同时发生、每隔几帧就有一格动一下，让观众感到产品能做的事很多。

content.en: Exactly four bricks that read at quarter size, each with a short label (≤ 14 chars, Chinese ≤ 6 characters), a start frame and a tone.
content.zh: 正好四块在四分之一画面里也看得清的积木，各配一枚短标签（≤ 14 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字）、起动帧和色调。

fits.zh: 四个功能或结果同时出现，各带自己的小动作。

notFor.zh: 要全屏才看得清的积木（字小于四分之一画面的下限）；多于或少于四件事；安静的段落。

en: Stagger the starts so no two quarters hit a heavy event on the same frame; four at once is the usual failure.
About 2 s of bombardment is the limit; longer needs a second event per quarter.
zh: 起动要错开，任何一帧都不该有两格同时出重事件；四格同时弹入是最常见的退化。
轰炸段约 2 秒是上限；再长要给每格加第二轮事件。

upstream.name: 四宫并行蒙太奇
upstream.summary: 画面硬切 2×2 四宫格，四个象限并行跑各自的微场景（打字、急推、逐词、交互链），关键节拍错开 3–6 帧制造信息轰炸
upstream.use: 节奏段"功能很多、同时发生"的蒙太奇拍；预告片中段的密度峰值
upstream.energy: 高（四线并行 + 错拍冲击，标准的 BGM 副歌位）

overlaps.note: three-angles shows one subject at three framings; quad-montage shows four bricks side by side

waive.all: the cells hold any brick, so nothing pairs with the upstream's four fixed scenes; the grid, the start offsets 0 / 4 / 8 / 16 frames (here per cell, at least 3 apart) and the chips are the upstream's, and each cell's brick has its own compare
